entries.title: Character Scale

entries.title: Google 3D Tiles
entries.summary: Streams Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles (the Google Earth dataset) as a full globe with distance-based LOD, re-centered on a configurable lat/lon so the chosen city builds up around the player; supports ground altitude tuning, detail factor, miniature-globe scaling, and camera far-clip override.

entries.title: Hello World
entries.summary: Smallest possible Arrival.Space plugin showing the basic script shape and lifecycle entry point.

entries.title: Hover Board
entries.summary: Rideable hover board with avatar animation hooks, player input handling, standing-object logic, and dynamic physics.

entries.title: Dynamic Iframe UI
entries.summary: Dynamic world-space information panel built with createHTMLPanel and iframe or CSS-driven content.

entries.title: Localized Light Probe
entries.summary: Spatial light probe volume with radius-based falloff that can override primary light direction/color, environment HDR, and post-effects as the player enters the volume.

entries.title: Firework Marker FX
entries.summary: Listens to a picked cutscene entity's timeline markers and spawns firework effects — ascent flames on launch/trail cues and a particle burst on the explode cue. Matches markers by explicit event name or by keyword in the marker label/id, and can hide a chosen rocket entity on detonation.

entries.title: NPC Character
entries.summary: Spawns an NPC that follows the local player — demonstrates createNPC, avatar setup, a click callback, and per-slot animations (Idle/Walk/Jump) driven by a catalog clip or a custom Mixamo .fbx upload that the platform auto-converts to a generic clip and retargets onto the avatar (VRM and modular/RPM).

entries.title: Outfit Override
entries.summary: Temporarily overrides the player's avatar outfit parts and shows how to restore them on cleanup.

entries.title: Persistent Inventory
entries.summary: Cross-space collectible: drop on an entity, walk near to collect, and the record follows the user into every other space that uses the same inventoryId. Demonstrates per-user persistent storage (ArrivalSpace.userData), an inventory:pickup / inventory:change event bus, a shared top-right HUD with single-owner hand-off between instances, and a toggle-as-action reset pattern.

entries.title: Physics Box
entries.summary: Basic rigidbody and collision example for a simple physics-enabled object.

entries.title: Floating Cutscene Button
entries.summary: A floating 3D button built from PlayCanvas primitives that plays a selected cutscene entity when clicked. Demonstrates the entity picker (filterTypes: ['cutscene']), getCutsceneScript().playCutscene(), an editor action button, billboard facing, bob animation, click cooldown, max-distance check, and an error flash.

entries.title: PostProcessVolume
entries.summary: Local post-effects blend volume that smoothly overrides room post-processing as the player moves through space.

entries.title: Ragdoll Physics
entries.summary: Procedural avatar ragdoll: builds capsule rigid bodies and cone/hinge constraints from the player skeleton (RPM/Mixamo/VRM), auto-activates on velocity-delta impact with separate horizontal/vertical thresholds, transfers pre-impact velocity to bones, and tracks the head with the player capsule so the camera follows the fall.

entries.title: VRM Tuning & Debug
entries.summary: Live control panel + visualizer for the engine's native VRM systems (which run automatically for every loaded VRM). It does NOT simulate anything itself: spring-bone sliders (simulate spring bones, eye blink, ropiness/locomotion momentum, air resistance, stiffness/gravity/drag multipliers, extra drag, collision iterations) write straight into the global window.VRMSpringBones, and toon-material sliders (diffuse R/G/B, emissive, ambient, specular, shininess, reflectivity, glossiness, skybox, tonemap) write into window.VRMToonMaterial and call retuneAll() to re-shade every VRM material already in the scene. Debug Draw Colliders/Bones render the engine's actual solver state (read from VRMSpringBones._solvers) — the real world-space spheres, capsules and bone segments collision uses. Removing the plugin restores the globals to their pre-session values.

entries.title: Simple Chat
entries.summary: Multiplayer chat example using ArrivalSpace.net messages plus synced values for lightweight shared UI state.

entries.title: Snowfall Particle Plugin
entries.summary: Configurable snowfall effect built with the PlayCanvas particle system, tunable curves, wind, and custom texture support.

entries.title: Procedural Splats - Snow
entries.summary: Flattened GSplat snow cover that raycasts onto collision surfaces and builds soft packed snow clumps instead of round blobs.

entries.title: Scavenger Hunt
entries.summary: Controller plugin that discovers Scavenger Item entities via getPlugins and the plugin event bus, tracks proximity-based collection, and displays a progress HUD with a finish overlay.

entries.title: Scavenger Item
entries.summary: Gizmo-positionable collectible marker that announces itself via the plugin event bus. Supports a default box visual or custom GLB model with bob and rotate animation.

entries.title: Scene Tour Camera
entries.summary: Overlay panel listing every user-placed entity; clicking one switches to free cam and frames it via setFreeCamPose with AABB-based distance, optional smooth flight, and auto-orbit. Showcases getCameraMode/setCameraMode, getUIContainer, and userModelEntity discovery.

entries.title: Sound Trigger
entries.summary: Plays a sound when the player gets close to the object, demonstrating proximity-based audio behavior.

entries.title: Sound Press Button
entries.summary: Clickable 3D HTML button that plays, pauses, stops, or toggles a referenced Custom Sound entity via entity picker, with optional keyboard shortcut and editor action buttons.

entries.title: Scene Tour Camera
entries.summary: Overlay list of every user-placed entity; click an entry to switch to free cam and fly/frame it. Demonstrates getUIContainer, setFreeCamPose, setCameraMode/getCameraMode, lockInput/unlockInput, AABB-based framing, smooth fly-to, and optional auto-orbit cancelled by manual input.

entries.title: Procedural Splats - Fire
entries.summary: Animated GSplat fire effect with flame, smoke, and sparks driven by CPU-updated splat data.

entries.title: Procedural Splats - Fog
entries.summary: Box-shaped volumetric fog volume built from a uniform GSplat lattice with editable size, alpha, and overlap.

entries.title: Procedural Splats - Grass
entries.summary: Dense procedural grass field made from anisotropic GSplats, with blade height, width, lean, and spawn control.

entries.title: Lamp
entries.summary: Physical lamp with a GLB model, rigidbody collision, configurable point or cone light, shadows, splat lighting, and electric flicker effect.

entries.title: Vehicle Physics Model
entries.summary: Driveable Ammo.js vehicle with custom chassis and wheel GLBs, suspension, headlights, and desktop/mobile mount controls.

entries.title: Splat Shader
entries.summary: Loads a Gaussian Splat via loadSplat and applies custom GLSL vertex/fragment shaders with animated uniforms.

entries.title: Splat Reveal
entries.summary: Plays a configurable reveal animation on the space's already-loaded unified / LOD-streaming Gaussian splat by overriding the engine's gsplatCustomizeVS hook (modifyCenter / modifyCovariance / modifyColor). Patterns include radial wave, sweep up/down, rain, scatter, dissolve and a brightness-driven 'bloom' where the brightest splats ignite first with a flare and twinkle; each splat grows from a dot with per-splat jitter, entrance motion (fall/scatter/rise), a settle hop, glow, and a one-shot scale bump at the end. Driven on the GPU from uProgress/uTime, disables itself when a non-looping reveal completes, and restores the original chunk on unload.
